text: France believes Iranian state backed hackers were behind the massive Freezer cyberattack that hit supermarkets a couple of weeks ago, Reuters reports.

🚨 The US State Department now lists 23 countries at Level 4, "Do Not Travel", citing security risks.

They include Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, Sudan, South Sudan, Libya, Somalia, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Afghanistan and North Korea.

Iran's Tasnim agency denies reports that Mohsen Rezaei met Vice President JD Vance in Doha.

A senior Tehran security official says Iran's stance on talks is unchanged, with none planned until the US takes concrete steps under Iran's seven conditions.

Sudan's army has struck a convoy of the Rapid Support Forces with a commercial drone dropping munitions from the air.

The footage appears to show a DJI Mavic or Matrice drone releasing a high explosive fragmentation mortar bomb onto the RSF vehicles.

President Trump is set to meet Qatar, the main Iran war mediator, but no deal to end the war is seen as imminent.

Trump is said to be weighing an Iranian offer to reopen Hormuz for $8 billion in frozen assets. Iran's Fars agency denies any such talks.

President Trump asks in a new Truth Social post whether anyone really believes the election was honest, and how the polls could be so wrong.

He claims some early voting "dumps" were too large to beat and says it is all about the machines.

An Iranian source tells Reuters that last night's US strikes on Qeshm Island damaged several military systems.

Among those hit were naval mine laying systems, radar systems and maritime navigation systems.

🚨 The White House has been placed on lockdown after a man rammed a car into a sign at the north end of Lafayette Square Park.

He fought with Secret Service agents and National Guard soldiers before being detained. Reporters on the North Lawn were ordered inside.

Prime Minister Netanyahu is calling for a unity government with the ultra Orthodox parties and every other Zionist party, led by his Likud as the largest party.

He says Israel cannot fight Iran and radical Islam while relying on Hamas supporters in government.

Russia has fitted its Iskander M missiles with new seekers to hit the Dnieper bridges in Kyiv more accurately.

The 9E436 electro optical and 9B918 radar seekers scan the target in the final seconds of flight and correct the course.

Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will meet Ukraine, the EU, NATO, Germany, France, the UK and Italy ahead of two days of US, Ukraine and Russia talks in Abu Dhabi.

It is the first three way round since February, aimed at a path to lasting peace.

🚨 President Trump says Israel must repay the United States for the cost of the Iran war.

It comes hours after he said countries America has protected will cover all the costs.

European officials fear US negotiators are echoing Kremlin talking points ahead of this week's Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

Critics see Washington's call for a "broader European security architecture" as an early win for Russia.
President Trump says Iran is "dying" to reach an agreement.

Follow up: Iraqi PM Ali al Zaidi spent hours in Tehran on Friday with Speaker Qalibaf, Fars reports, talking only about ending the war with the US.

Qalibaf presented Iran's "two day proposal" and said Washington must respect Iran's rights for talks to advance.
The death toll from a steel plant explosion in Izmir, western Turkey, has climbed to 10, with another 15 people injured, reports say.

More Iranian ballistic missile launches are being reported, the latest spotted near Kuhestan Park in Yazd, central Iran.

The launches may be part of ongoing military drills.

🚨 Vice President JD Vance is expected to meet Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, in Doha next week, Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin says.

There is no US confirmation so far.
Gulf stock markets gained on Monday on hopes that new strikes on Iran will stay off the table.

Bipartisan support for Israel in Washington is eroding, with voices in both parties pushing for new limits.

Vice President JD Vance is among the Republicans calling for change, while many Democrats want to restrict military aid to Israel.
